player_facing_text: "Evening's seen better days," Osric says, voice low and reserved. "The work's steady enough, but the river's been restless, and folks keep an uneasy eye on it. Nothing more I can say that'd brighten the mood." He shifts beside the lantern, his gaze briefly flicking to the darkening water before settling back on you.
